depth_first_rationale: The customer addresses one concern at a time — first the dispute, then accepts the card cancellation when offered, and only after resolution asks about refund timing.
uncertainty_rationale: In a certain-fraud scenario the customer is appropriately assertive ('yes thats literally what i said') without sounding robotic or over-committing with filler affirmations.
